title: Scenario runner: a recorded replay re-sends no MCP write, so every applied operation fails on replay
body:
epic:#33595#1 · os-tesla · session_01L9qiby1cctpVpRbJzjccvY

Filing-gate category: ③ maintainer-directed child of #33595 (M2 row of its milestone table). Maintainer, 2026-11-15 02:10Z: 「你建议的任务全部立卡，你负责开 devx 车道派发处理」; 08:36Z, on the epic seat's decision card "M2/M3 的行现在立卡吗?立了交给谁派发?": "立卡,留给本专题席位派发". Also ① tooling defect with a measured reproduction (eval#1, 2026-11-15).

## Mechanism

`packages/qa/scenarios/src/runner/driver.ts` `RecordedDriver.ask()` returns the recorded `ParsedTurn` for the step key and sends nothing. The tool calls in that turn, including the agent's MCP writes, never reach the freshly booted app. The runner then reads the operation's effect back from that app (`observe.ts`), finds no row, and grades an `applied` operation as failed. Measured by eval#1 on `main` `36936440`: haiku `crm_account_with_contacts` operations 3/5 live → 1/4 on replay, `add_contact` "0 row(s) read back".

## Why it matters

Replay is how the eval seat re-scores recorded runs after a grader change without paying for models again. It is valid for Build and 问数 today, but operation scores on replay are false fails, so the operations half cannot be re-scored and every replay table has to footnote it.

## Done when

- On `--driver recorded:F`, each operation turn's recorded MCP write calls are re-sent to the booted app as the same persona, in order, before the read-back. Alternatively, when a turn cannot be re-sent faithfully, every operation it carries is NOT MEASURED with a named reason, never failed.
- A test replays a recorded `applied` operation and reads the row back. A recorded refused write still gets its refusal.
- The eval#1 measurement above is reproduced green, or reported as not measured with its reason.

## Reader

The epic seat `epic:#33595#1` dispatches it to `os-dev` (`domain:devx`, `packages/qa/scenarios`), serial with the other M2 runner cards where files overlap.

Dedup: `repo:objectstack-ai/objectstack is:issue recorded driver replay applied` → 206 hits; the top ones (#33676, #33411) are other defects, all closed; none names replay of operation writes.
